output.headline: UPMC has bought only in the target's own sub-sector, closed all three deals, and has US$27.7 billion of revenue behind a Midwest entry.
output.differentiator: All three of its deals sit in the target's own sub-sector and all closed (3 of 3). It is a strategic buyer with no deals in adjacent sub-sectors, so its record is focused.
output.why_them: Strategic with a pure same-sub-sector record; Midwest entry

acquirer_overview.title: A strategic provider with a focused, fully closed record
points: Strategic buyer with revenue of US$27.7 billion (2023); hospitals in Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York [P:1, P:2].
Three deals from 2018 to 2020, all in the target's own sub-sector, all control deals, and all closed [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Washington Health System merged with UPMC in 2024; no acquisition has been recorded since 2022 [P:2, K:recent].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Same-sub-sector focus makes the target a natural fit
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor in its likelihood; the target's margin fit is a strong factor [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit].
Platform build and cross-sell each drove 1 of 3 deals, tags that are less common across the file than geographic expansion [M:platform_build, M:cross_sell].
It ranks 3rd on the priority list with a 4.7% likelihood. It has no deal in the Midwest, so this would be a regional entry [R:rank, T:record].

precedent_activity.title: Three same-sub-sector deals, one of them larger than the target
points: Principal Behavioral Health: $444M bolt-on, 2019, 11.7x EBITDA, Closed [D:MA-2019-0090].
Sterling Care Network: $55M strategic acquisition, 2020, 11.3x [D:MA-2020-0312]. Keystone Behavioral Health: $33M recapitalization, 2018, 17.0x [D:MA-2018-0486].
None of the three falls in the $100M-$400M size band, and the last deal was in 2020 [K:size_band, T:record].

valuation_context.title: A 75th-percentile ask is defensible; UPMC's history sits lower
points: Comparable deals (70) show 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x at the median and 15.3x at the 75th [V:comps].
The target's 16.8% margin beats the comps' 12.9% median and sits above 87% of comps, supporting the 75th percentile [V:comps].
UPMC's median paid is 11.7x, but synergy headroom of $15M-$25M and US$27.7 billion of revenue support a stretch [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Price gap to the ask
risk_flags.concern: UPMC's median paid of 11.7x is below the 12.8x comparable median and the 15.3x 75th percentile [V:comps].
risk_flags.mitigant: Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M could bridge part of the gap [V:synergy].
risk_flags.reality: Expect an opening bid below the 75th percentile unless competing bidders push it up [V:comps].

risk_flags.title: No Midwest footprint
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's region; hospitals are in Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York [T:record, P:2].
risk_flags.mitigant: Geographic expansion drove 2 of its 3 deals [M:geographic_expansion].
risk_flags.reality: That motive is common across the file, so it is weak evidence of a Midwest move [M:geographic_expansion].

risk_flags.title: Dormant acquirer
risk_flags.concern: Last deal was in 2020, and none since 2022; recency is a slight factor against [K:recent, S:recency].
risk_flags.mitigant: Washington Health System merged with UPMC in 2024 [P:2].
risk_flags.reality: The record is only three deals, so appetite should be tested on the call [T:record].

conviction.rationale: All 3 deals are in the target's own sub-sector and none in adjacent ones, and UPMC is among the 3 highest-scored buyers after review (#3). Having no deal in the target's region is treated as neutral [C:conviction].
